                <a id="cb_post_title_url" class="postTitle2 vertical-middle" href="https://www.cnblogs.com/aqi00/p/21136970" title="发布于 2026-07-05 11:08">
    <span role="heading" aria-level="2">15天学会AI应用开发（十一）从TXT文件构建RAG知识库</span>
    

</a>

            </h1>
            <div class="clear"></div>
            <div class="postBody">
                <div id="cnblogs_post_body" class="blogpost-body blogpost-body-html">
前面的文章在构建RAG并检索时，既使用了国外大模型，也使用了国内大模型；既运用了内存向量检索库FAISS，也运用了磁盘向量数据库Chroma。
<p>但知识库的原始来源却是knowledge数组，这与现实场合有所出入，因为实际资料都保存在TXT、PDF、WORD等格式的文档中，甚至来自互联网上的HTML网页，于是RAG的前置条件就成了如何从这些文档中提取文本信息。</p>
<h1>一、读取TXT文件中的文本</h1>
<p>TXT文件是最简单的文本格式，读写TXT无需任何第三方库。<br>
Python代码先调用open函数打开TXT，再调用read函数读取全部文本内容，也可循环调用readline函数依次读取每行文本。</p>
<p>比如下面代码依次读取TXT文件的每行文本，并把各行文本依次添加到知识库数组knowledge中。</p>
<div class="cke_widget_wrapper cke_widget_block cke_widget_codeSnippet cke_widget_selected" data-cke-display-name="代码段" data-cke-filter="off" data-cke-widget-id="3" data-cke-widget-wrapper="1">
<pre class="cke_widget_element" data-cke-widget-data="%7B%22code%22%3A%22%23%20%3D%3D%3D%3D%3D%3D%3D%3D%3D%3D%3D%3D%3D%3D%3D%3D%3D%3D%3D%3D%3D%20%E4%BB%8E%E6%96%87%E6%9C%AC%E6%96%87%E4%BB%B6%E8%AF%BB%E5%8F%96%E7%9F%A5%E8%AF%86%E5%BA%93%EF%BC%88%E6%9B%BF%E4%BB%A3%E5%8E%9F%E6%95%B0%E7%BB%84%EF%BC%89%20%3D%3D%3D%3D%3D%3D%3D%3D%3D%3D%3D%3D%3D%3D%3D%3D%3D%3D%3D%3D%3D%5Cndef%20load_knowledge_from_txt(file_path)%3A%5Cn%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20knowledge%20%3D%20%5B%5D%5Cn%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20with%20open(file_path%2C%20%5C%22r%5C%22%2C%20encoding%3D%5C%22utf-8%5C%22)%20as%20f%3A%5Cn%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20for%20line%20in%20f%3A%5Cn%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20line%20%3D%20line.strip()%5Cn%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20if%20line%3A%20%C2%A0%23%20%E9%9D%9E%E7%A9%BA%E8%A1%8C%E6%89%8D%E5%8A%A0%E5%85%A5%5Cn%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20knowledge.append(line)%5Cn%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20return%20knowledge%5Cn%5Cn%23%20%E5%8A%A0%E8%BD%BD%E7%9F%A5%E8%AF%86%EF%BC%88%E8%87%AA%E5%8A%A8%E8%AF%BB%20knowledge.txt%EF%BC%89%5Cnknowledge%20%3D%20load_knowledge_from_txt(%5C%22knowledge.txt%5C%22)%22%2C%22classes%22%3Anull%7D" data-cke-widget-keep-attr="0" data-cke-widget-upcasted="1" data-widget="codeSnippet"><code class="hljs"># ===================== 从文本文件读取知识库（替代原数组） =====================
def load_knowledge_from_txt(file_path):
&nbsp; &nbsp; knowledge = []
&nbsp; &nbsp; with open(file_path, "r", encoding="utf-8") as f:
&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; for line in f:
&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; line = line.strip()
&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; if line: &nbsp;# 非空行才加入
&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; knowledge.append(line)
&nbsp; &nbsp; return knowledge

# 加载知识（自动读 knowledge.txt）
knowledge = load_knowledge_from_txt("knowledge.txt")</code></pre>
</div>
<h1>二、兼容GBK字符集的TXT文件</h1>
<p>首先确保Python代码的同目录下存在knowledge.txt，并且文件内容非空，再运行上面的Python测试代码。</p>
<p>可是Windows系统多半会报错“UnicodeDecodeError: 'utf-8' codec can't decode byte 0xca in position 4: invalid continuation byte”，这是因为Windows系统默认把TXT文件保存为ASCII编码，而非UTF-8编码。而Python代码企图以UTF-8编码打开TXT，就会报编码格式不符的错误了。</p>
<p>为了解决字符集编码冲突的问题，需要改造前面的Python代码，使得既支持UTF-8编码，又支持GBK形式的ASCII编码。<br>
改造后的Python文件读取代码如下：</p>
<div class="cke_widget_wrapper cke_widget_block cke_widget_codeSnippet cke_widget_selected" data-cke-display-name="代码段" data-cke-filter="off" data-cke-widget-id="2" data-cke-widget-wrapper="1">
<pre class="cke_widget_element" data-cke-widget-data="%7B%22code%22%3A%22%23%20%3D%3D%3D%3D%3D%3D%3D%3D%3D%3D%3D%3D%3D%3D%3D%3D%3D%3D%3D%3D%3D%20%E4%BB%8E%E6%96%87%E6%9C%AC%E6%96%87%E4%BB%B6%E8%AF%BB%E5%8F%96%E7%9F%A5%E8%AF%86%E5%BA%93%EF%BC%88%E6%9B%BF%E4%BB%A3%E5%8E%9F%E6%95%B0%E7%BB%84%EF%BC%89%20%3D%3D%3D%3D%3D%3D%3D%3D%3D%3D%3D%3D%3D%3D%3D%3D%3D%3D%3D%3D%3D%5Cndef%20load_knowledge_from_txt(file_path)%3A%5Cn%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20knowledge%20%3D%20%5B%5D%5Cn%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20encoding_type%20%3D%20%5C%22utf-8%5C%22%5Cn%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20try%3A%5Cn%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20with%20open(file_path%2C%20%5C%22r%5C%22%2C%20encoding%3Dencoding_type)%20as%20f%3A%5Cn%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20f.readline()%5Cn%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20except%3A%5Cn%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20encoding_type%20%3D%20%5C%22gbk%5C%22%5Cn%5Cn%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20with%20open(file_path%2C%20%5C%22r%5C%22%2C%20encoding%3Dencoding_type)%20as%20f%3A%5Cn%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20for%20line%20in%20f%3A%5Cn%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20line%20%3D%20line.strip()%5Cn%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20if%20line%3A%20%C2%A0%23%20%E9%9D%9E%E7%A9%BA%E8%A1%8C%E6%89%8D%E5%8A%A0%E5%85%A5%5Cn%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20knowledge.append(line)%5Cn%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20return%20knowledge%5Cn%5Cn%23%20%E5%8A%A0%E8%BD%BD%E7%9F%A5%E8%AF%86%EF%BC%88%E8%87%AA%E5%8A%A8%E8%AF%BB%20knowledge.txt%EF%BC%89%5Cnknowledge%20%3D%20load_knowledge_from_txt(%5C%22knowledge.txt%5C%22)%22%2C%22classes%22%3Anull%7D" data-cke-widget-keep-attr="0" data-cke-widget-upcasted="1" data-widget="codeSnippet"><code class="hljs"># ===================== 从文本文件读取知识库（替代原数组） =====================
def load_knowledge_from_txt(file_path):
&nbsp; &nbsp; knowledge = []
&nbsp; &nbsp; encoding_type = "utf-8"
&nbsp; &nbsp; try:
&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; with open(file_path, "r", encoding=encoding_type) as f:
&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; f.readline()
&nbsp; &nbsp; except:
&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; encoding_type = "gbk"

&nbsp; &nbsp; with open(file_path, "r", encoding=encoding_type) as f:
&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; for line in f:
&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; line = line.strip()
&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; if line: &nbsp;# 非空行才加入
&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; knowledge.append(line)
&nbsp; &nbsp; return knowledge

# 加载知识（自动读 knowledge.txt）
knowledge = load_knowledge_from_txt("knowledge.txt")</code></pre>
</div>
<p>可见上面代码先以UTF-8方式打开TXT，如果遇到异常再以GBK方式打开TXT，从而实现了同时兼容UTF-8与GBK的目标。</p>
<h1>三、对文本内容自动分块</h1>
<p>不过TXT文件中的文本很可能不是一句话一行字，而是一段一段的文字，每段都包含好几个句子，那么上面代码依次调用readline函数并添加到数组，每个数组元素都包含一大段文字，十分臃肿。</p>
<p>为此需要根据句号来拆分文本内容，而非根据段落来拆分文本内容。基本要求如下：</p>
<p>1、读取TXT文件的所有文本内容。<br>
2、按照句号分割文本。<br>
3、每条知识设定字数下限，比如不得少于50个汉字；如果某条知识小于这个长度，就要跟下一条知识合并。<br>
4、处理过程注意去除无效字符，例如剔除空行、删除空格等等。</p>
<p>根据上述逻辑，可编写自动分块的Python测试代码如下：</p>
<div class="cke_widget_wrapper cke_widget_block cke_widget_codeSnippet cke_widget_selected" data-cke-display-name="代码段" data-cke-filter="off" data-cke-widget-id="1" data-cke-widget-wrapper="1">
<pre class="cke_widget_element" data-cke-widget-data="%7B%22code%22%3A%22%23%20%3D%3D%3D%3D%3D%3D%3D%3D%3D%3D%3D%3D%3D%3D%3D%3D%3D%3D%3D%3D%3D%20%E5%8A%A0%E8%BD%BD%E4%B8%80%E6%95%B4%E6%AE%B5%20TXT%20%E6%96%87%E6%9C%AC%20%3D%3D%3D%3D%3D%3D%3D%3D%3D%3D%3D%3D%3D%3D%3D%3D%3D%3D%3D%3D%3D%5Cndef%20load_text(file_path)%3A%5Cn%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20try%3A%5Cn%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20with%20open(file_path%2C%20%5C%22r%5C%22%2C%20encoding%3D%5C%22utf-8%5C%22)%20as%20f%3A%5Cn%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20return%20f.read().strip()%5Cn%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20except%3A%5Cn%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20with%20open(file_path%2C%20%5C%22r%5C%22%2C%20encoding%3D%5C%22gbk%5C%22)%20as%20f%3A%5Cn%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20return%20f.read().strip()%5Cn%5Cn%23%20%E8%AF%BB%E5%8F%96%E4%B8%80%E6%95%B4%E6%AE%B5%E6%96%87%E6%9C%AC%5Cnraw_text%20%3D%20load_text(%5C%22knowledge.txt%5C%22)%5Cn%5Cn%23%20%3D%3D%3D%3D%3D%3D%3D%3D%3D%3D%3D%3D%3D%3D%3D%3D%3D%3D%3D%3D%3D%20%E8%87%AA%E5%8A%A8%E6%8A%8A%E4%B8%80%E6%AE%B5%E6%96%87%E5%AD%97%E5%88%87%E6%88%90%E5%A4%9A%E6%AE%B5%EF%BC%88%E5%85%B3%E9%94%AE%EF%BC%81%EF%BC%89%20%3D%3D%3D%3D%3D%3D%3D%3D%3D%3D%3D%3D%3D%3D%3D%3D%3D%3D%3D%3D%3D%5Cndef%20split_text(text%2C%20max_len%3D50)%3A%5Cn%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20sentences%20%3D%20text.split(%5C%22%E3%80%82%5C%22)%20%C2%A0%23%20%E6%8C%89%E5%8F%A5%E5%8F%B7%E5%88%86%E5%89%B2%5Cn%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20chunks%20%3D%20%5B%5D%5Cn%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20current%20%3D%20%5C%22%5C%22%5Cn%5Cn%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20for%20sen%20in%20sentences%3A%5Cn%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20sen%20%3D%20sen.strip()%5Cn%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20if%20not%20sen%3A%5Cn%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20continue%5Cn%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20%23%20%E5%8A%A0%E5%9B%9E%E5%8E%BB%E5%8F%A5%E5%8F%B7%EF%BC%8C%E8%AE%A9%E8%AF%AD%E4%B9%89%E5%AE%8C%E6%95%B4%5Cn%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20sen%20%2B%3D%20%5C%22%E3%80%82%5C%22%5Cn%5Cn%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20if%20len(current)%20%3C%3D%20max_len%3A%5Cn%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20current%20%2B%3D%20sen%5Cn%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20else%3A%5Cn%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20if%20current%3A%5Cn%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20chunks.append(current.strip())%5Cn%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20current%20%3D%20sen%5Cn%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20if%20current%3A%5Cn%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20chunks.append(current.strip())%5Cn%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20return%20chunks%5Cn%5Cn%23%20%E8%87%AA%E5%8A%A8%E5%88%86%E5%9D%97%5Cnknowledge%20%3D%20split_text(raw_text)%22%2C%22classes%22%3Anull%7D" data-cke-widget-keep-attr="0" data-cke-widget-upcasted="1" data-widget="codeSnippet"><code class="hljs"># ===================== 加载一整段 TXT 文本 =====================
def load_text(file_path):
&nbsp; &nbsp; try:
&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; with open(file_path, "r", encoding="utf-8") as f:
&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; return f.read().strip()
&nbsp; &nbsp; except:
&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; with open(file_path, "r", encoding="gbk") as f:
&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; return f.read().strip()

# 读取一整段文本
raw_text = load_text("knowledge.txt")

# ===================== 自动把一段文字切成多段（关键！） =====================
def split_text(text, max_len=50):
&nbsp; &nbsp; sentences = text.split("。") &nbsp;# 按句号分割
&nbsp; &nbsp; chunks = []
&nbsp; &nbsp; current = ""

&nbsp; &nbsp; for sen in sentences:
&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; sen = sen.strip()
&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; if not sen:
&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; continue
&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; # 加回去句号，让语义完整
&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; sen += "。"

&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; if len(current) &lt;= max_len:
&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; current += sen
&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; else:
&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; if current:
&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; chunks.append(current.strip())
&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; current = sen
&nbsp; &nbsp; if current:
&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; chunks.append(current.strip())
&nbsp; &nbsp; return chunks

# 自动分块
knowledge = split_text(raw_text)</code></pre>
</div>
<p>至此初步实现了对TXT文件的读取和分块功能，拆分后的每条知识仍然保存于knowledge数组，后续的RAG构建及检索操作可套用之前的RAG测试代码框架。</p>
